title: Dyadic bias of the shifted generator
statement: Let $n,\ell,t$ be natural numbers such that $\ell\ne0$, $t\le\ell$, and $n=2^{\ell-t}$. The probability density on $\mathbb F_2^n$ obtained by choosing the shifted small bias generator uniformly from its parameter space is biased with parameter $2^{-t}-2^{-\ell}$: every nonzero vector Fourier coefficient has absolute value at most this quantity.
